Nora (PM): Quick sync: customers say console cost/latency preview for saved per-route queries doesn't match runtime because preview picks a different model. Can we make previews reflect the saved config by default?

Eli (Backend): We only persist model_hint in saved_query right now. To be accurate we either store deterministic_model_id when the user pins an exact version, or run routing-service in preview mode to compute decision.

Priya (Console): UX: default preview = 'as saved' when opening a saved query. Add a small switch 'Preview as: saved | live' and a badge showing model provenance (Pinned / Route default / Fallback).

Omar (Routing): Server-side preview makes sense. API: POST /savedqueries/{id}/preview -> call routing.apply with preview flag, return model_id, policy_version, estimate_tokens, p95_ms, cost_cents, reason_code. Make sure we include a cache_key and TTL.

Zoe (Telemetry): Mark all preview calls preview=true and add preview_mode & preview_model_id. Exclude previews from billing aggregates. Also emit a trace span for routing.apply so we can investigate mismatches after rollouts.

deploy-bot: routing-service v2 canary window tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

Eli (Backend): Short-term: client-side optimistic preview using pinned model_hint (label as approximate). Long-term: server preview endpoint with rate-limits (per-user + global) and 60s memoization.

Priya (Console): I'll mock the toggle + badge and include the microcopy: "Estimate based on saved config; actual model may differ if capacity changes."

Nora (PM): Action items: Eli spec endpoint + auth, Omar wire policy_version, Priya mocks, Zoe telemetry contract. We'll reconvene after prototypes. Thanks!
